answer: Each agent stakes bonded collateral in a shared vault, and a sybil identity must independently fund a distinct vertex in the trust graph, making mass forgery capital-expensive. Validators cross-check synchrophasor-style attestations across that graph, so fake nodes cannot fake correlated inertia like counterfeit timber in a load-bearing frame. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
